usageGuidelines: Join returned rows to Mirror Pulse by as_of_date plus ticker or CIK.
Rows are retrospective recomputations from the latest CompanyFacts archive, constrained to facts with filed <= as_of_date.
Use full mode only for selected audit pages because factor_payload can be larger.

description: Use this read-only structured history tool when Mirror Pulse, backtests, or agents need daily ATLAS-7 CompanyFacts-derived factor rows keyed by as_of_date. It returns point-in-time-safe rows derived from the latest CompanyFacts archive by applying only facts with filed <= as_of_date; rows are retrospective recomputations and include lookahead safety flags. Parameters: optional ticker or CIK, source_date, as_of_date_from, as_of_date_to, mode=compact|full, limit, and offset. Behavior: read-only and idempotent; it performs one HTTPS read, has no destructive side effects, does not generate Natural Language, and never executes trades, wallets, or settlement flows. Use compact mode by default for Mirror Pulse joins; use full mode only for selected audit pages because factor_payload can be larger.

as_of_date_from.description: Optional inclusive as-of date lower bound in YYYY-MM-DD format.

as_of_date_to.description: Optional inclusive as-of date upper bound in YYYY-MM-DD format.

cik.description: Optional CIK filter. Bare digits or CIK-prefixed digits are accepted.

limit.description: Maximum daily factor rows to return. Defaults to 250 on REST and is capped lower on MCP.

mode.description: Optional response mode. Use compact by default; full includes factor_payload.

offset.description: Pagination offset for daily factor rows.

source_date.description: Optional CompanyFacts archive source date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

ticker.description: Optional issuer ticker filter, for example MSTR.
